name: How do I choose the right contractor for my interior renovation?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my interior renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for your interior renovation, look for experience, strong references, and proper licensing and insurance. Review their portfolio to assess the quality and style of their previous work. Obtain multiple bids, ensuring each contractor provides a detailed scope of work and a transparent cost breakdown. Effective communication, a clear contract, and a good rapport are also crucial for a successful project. Frasheski Construction serves the Berkeley, East Bay, Oakland, Albany, El Cerrito areas.
